outcome: Accuracy of antenatal identification of preterm birth
cohort: 3781 live births (257 preterm) at six hospitals in Uganda, Kenya, India and Pakistan
finding: Antenatal identification of preterm birth was good, but hypothermia was common among preterm infants, and mortality before hospital discharge was high.
mod_finding: Timing of cord clamping varied between hospitals, but at each hospital there was no difference in timing between term and preterm births.
